Step 5 - 10
If the TX_SDU_AVAILABLE flag is set, the FrTp module has to evaluate the length of
the currently available FrTp N-SDU data by calling the service primitive
PduR_FrTpCopyTxData() 14 a first time. With knowledge of the available
data size FrTp module scans the FrTpTxPduPool and allocates the first free
FrTpPdu for that data transfer. Depending on the available FrTp-N-SDU length and
the FrTpTxPduPool’s free FrTpPdu length the FrTp module decides whether
segmentation is necessary or not for that N-SDU transfer. By calling the service
primitive PduR_FrTpCopyTxData() the data shall be copied to the corresponding
buffer. In a next step the corresponding Address Information and PCI are prepared
and the service primitive FrIf_Transmit is called with the corresponding TxPduId.
